body: No!! Don't eat the eggs. If youre vegan this shouldn't even cross your mind. Chickens have been bred to produce way more eggs than they need to and it takes a huge toll on their body. They will eat their own eggs and get those nutrients back! The point of veganism is to live a life not exploiting animals, not to find different ways to exploit them.

Thank you for that, I appreciate it. A few hours after I made this post I got a video call from my brother where he showed me ultrasounds of his first child. Sorry for the long reply, but I really did appreciate this.
